visual_appeal: Hero card: below the 1.5 / LEVELS BANKED / FULL stack there is about 60 px of dead dark area beside the two status lines. Move the status lines under the bar to full width (230 to 775 px), or lift the FULL chip up by 6 px so the right stack ends level with the bar's top edge.

The steps strip (1 Le Jette / 2 Le Dette / View details) reads as a third visual style between the hero and NOW PLAYING. Give it the same well fill as the rows (about #2A2219 at 85%). Use a 1 px #5A4A32 top rule only, and drop the gold outline box around step 2 in favour of a 3 px gold left tick, so the window has one fewer bordered rectangle.
Row wells alternate so subtly that rows 5 to 7 blur together in ElvUI. Raise the zebra contrast to about +6% luminance (for example #241D16 and #2B231A) or add a 1 px #3A3024 divider at 60% alpha.
play_next_clarity: Hero status copy: 'Full since 1d 16h ago' is a since/ago redundancy. Write 'Full for 1d 16h' on one line in #7FD67F, with 'More rest is wasted' on the same line after a middle dot in the cream tier. This saves a line and reads as one thought.

'Then play Le Bankken, full in 19h 11m' floats centred under step 2 and looks orphaned. Make it step 3 with the same numbered disc ('3 Le Bankken: full in 19h 11m'), greyed, inline on the steps row. Or right-align it under View details at 12 px muted.
Step 2 is the real call to action. Make 'play now' the strongest text on the strip: 14 px bold in the class colour plus white, not the same weight as step 1.
state_colours: Jacques Hammer's bar uses a desaturated brick (#8A3A30-ish) while the chip and accent are a brighter red. Use one red for the bar fill, the accent and the chip border (about #D2402F) so RED reads as one state, not two shades.

The NEARLY FULL chip's yellow fill on a yellow border is the only filled chip. RESTING and NOT RESTING are outlined. Either fill all chips at 18% alpha of their state colour or none. A consistent treatment matters more than emphasis here.
Legend dots in the NEXT BEST header are about 8 px and the orange and red dots are close at that size. Raise them to 10 px and add a 1 px dark #000 at 60% ring.
character_identity: Race/gender badges overlap the class icon by about 40% and at about 18 px the faces are mush (Le Jedde's and Le Beouf's badges). Grow the badge to 22 px with a 1.5 px gold ring and offset it so it overlaps no more than 30%.

NOW PLAYING shows a class icon for the logged-in character in these renders. Make sure the live face path is what ships, and give the NOW PLAYING portrait the same 46 px diameter as the rows rather than its slightly smaller ring.

Card: the name 'Le Beouf' at about 18 px gold sits below the speech bubble and competes with it. Put the name directly above 'Level 11 Tauren Druid' at the top-left (y 70) and move the bubble beside the portrait at mid-height so identity is read first.
default_theme: Default title bar: the moon glyph plus title is centred, but the Compact button and X box are different heights (about 22 vs 20 px). Match them at 22 px and give X the same parchment bevel as Compact.

The Default hero uses a forest painting that pushes the cream sub-lines toward about 5:1 at the bright patches. Add a left-to-right gradient scrim (#000 at 55% to 0% over the left 60%) behind the text block.
View details in Default is gold-outlined and in ElvUI it is blue. That is fine per theme, but the Default version's 1 px border is lighter than the Compact button. Unify at #C8A050.
elvui_wc3_fit: The ElvUI Character and Options references use flat dark wells (#15110C) with thin gold-grey rules. The addon's hero well is warmer and lighter (about #2A2218). Darken the wells 2 to 3 steps toward #1A1510 so the window sits beside the Character pane without looking browner.

The ElvUI blue buttons (Compact, View details, Unlink, All accounts) match the skin, but All accounts sits mid-footer with no label. Write 'Accounts: All' or move it into the header as a filter chip so it does not read as an action.
Section labels such as ROSTER/TIMELINE should use the skin's caps style: same font as the Character pane's 'General' header, centred in a #2A2A2A plate, or at least the same 12 px caps tracking +1.
alerts_ux: Logout banner: the gear and red X sit 4 px apart at the top-right with View details 30 px below. Give the gear and X a 24 px hit box with 8 px spacing, and align View details' right edge with the X's right edge.

The 'Find an inn before you log out' card body is 12 px in the cream tier on a wood texture. Raise it to 13 px per the new scale and add a #000 at 40% inner panel behind the text so the planks do not stripe through the glyphs.

Toast title 'Le Jette: rested XP used up' in gold competes with 'Play Le Dette' in white. Make the action line the headline (14 px white) and the cause line the 12 px caps-free muted subline above it.

Move mode placeholders: the instructions ('Default position. Drag anywhere on this panel.') are 12 px over a dark wood texture. Use 13 px and put a 1 px dashed #C8A050 inner border on each placeholder so the draggable area is unmistakable.
readability: The 13 px meta line in rows ('Lv 8 Warrior · Goldshire inn · 3d ago') in the cream secondary tier is legible now but thin with the narrow face. Give the reading-tier font an OUTLINE-free 1 px #000 at 70% shadow at offset (1,-1) in ElvUI to match the skin's text.

Hero sub-meta ('Level 6 Gnome Warlock · Thunderbrew Distillery inn · seen 2d ago') is the longest line in the window. Truncate the inn to the town name at hero width (as the rows do) so it never wraps at 115% scale.
Timeline 'FULL AFTER 48h' dates wrap to two lines ('Wed 2 Dec' / '01:36'). Widen that column by about 24 px or use 'Wed 01:36' on one line, with the full date in the detail line on hover.
Compact tooltip: the % and time strings at the right are right-aligned, but the % values are not tabular (92% vs 9%). Pad them to a fixed 4-char column so the dots line up.
layout_polish: The grid works now: the chips share one right edge and NOW PLAYING's chip sits on it. Finish the job by aligning NOW PLAYING's 'No rested XP: kills give normal XP' baseline with the rows' bar line (it sits about 4 px high). Also align the rank numbers' x with the NOW PLAYING accent offset.
Timeline: '+48h' crowds into the 'FULL AFTER 48h' header and the last gridline butts against the wrapped dates. Inset the chart's right end by 8 px and right-align the +48h label to the line.
Timeline: Le Dette's 100% lane has no bar, only 'Full now', so the first lane looks empty. Draw a full-height green dot at Now with a short #7FD67F stub, so every lane has a glyph at x = Now.

Card: the tidbits grid has the left column icons at x 78 but the bar and text above start at x 75. Snap both to the same 16 px inset. The bottom tidbits panel also has about 14 px more padding at its bottom than its top, so equalise it.

Options: the left nav is empty apart from one entry, leaving about 190 px of dead column. Fine for Blizzard parity, but vertically space the right panel's sections at a consistent 14 px gap (APPEARANCE to ACCOUNTS is tighter than NOTIFICATIONS to WINDOW AND DISPLAY). Also split 'About  Builds on...' into a caps label and a body line.
Compact tooltip: the brown highlight block behind 'Rested Leveling / Play the top one first' looks like a stuck selection. Remove it or extend it full width as a proper header plate.
delight: The zZz on the resting card is lovely. Give the hero a matching tiny touch: a slow 2 s shimmer across the green bar when FULL (respect Reduce motion).
When the lane is hovered in the timeline, pulse that row's endpoint dot once (scale 1.0 to 1.3, 200 ms) so the hover feels alive.
Speech lines: allow a second short line like the card's ('Thunder Bluff suits me.') in the hero bubble too, so the hero feels as characterful as the card.

overall_notes: The systemic steer worked. The single column grid is visible: the chips form one clean right edge, % values sit in their own right-aligned column, NOW PLAYING's chip lines up with the roster, and the footer shares the left edge. Rows at 62 px with a 13 px second line read comfortably. This is the first round where readability and layout_polish are no longer the weak spots, and I am moving both to 8. What keeps everything from 9 is a layer of finish rather than structure. The hero has dead space and awkward 'Full since ... ago' copy. The 'Then play...' line floats. Red has two shades. The ElvUI wells are a touch warmer and lighter than the reference Character pane. The timeline's right edge crowds and wraps. Alerts have small, tightly packed corner controls. The compact tooltip has a stray header highlight. None of these needs a new system; together they are the difference between a very good addon and one a demanding user approves without notes.
